name: step-indicator
title: Step indicator
description: Bars for each step with one tooltip that slides to the step you point at.

props.name: current
props.description: Index of the step the person is on. Earlier steps are filled.

a11y.text: Each bar is a native button, so Tab visits them in order and Enter or Space calls onStepChange with its index. Focusing a bar shows its name above it, like hover.
The bars sit in a nav named by label (default Progress). Each button is named N. <step label>, and the current one has aria-current step. The floating name is aria-hidden.
The component is wrapped in MotionConfig with reducedMotion set to user, so Motion follows the system setting for the sliding name.
